description: Connection inventory. These are design records, not Fabric REST request bodies. Credentials are kept in approved connections/Key Vault.

sources.label: Azure SQL Database
sources.authentication: Source-supported Entra or dedicated database principal
sources.validation: Initial snapshot then insert/update/delete observed in replica

sources.label: Azure Databse for PostgresSQL
sources.authentication: Dedicated source account per connector requirements
sources.validation: Replication settings, schema/type support and snapshot/change propagation

sources.label: Azure Cosmos DB
sources.validation: NoSQL API and backup mode prerequisites; inserts, updates and deletes

sources.label: Azure Databricks
sources.authentication: Unity Catalog permissions plus supported storage access
sources.validation: Catalog/table metadata and underlying Delta access; no assumed full replication

sources.label: Snowflake
sources.authentication: Dedicated mirroring role with connector-required grants

sources.label: On-premises datacenter
sources.authentication: On-premises data gateway and restricted source login
sources.validation: Gateway connectivity, source version, incremental watermark and deletes

sources.label: Data Lake Storage
sources.authentication: Supported Fabric cloud connection with least-privilege storage access

sources.label: Amazon S3
sources.validation: Bucket/object access; no write permissions by default

sources.label: Dataverse
sources.validation: Managed shortcuts, updates and table availability

sources.label: Azure Event Hubs
sources.authentication: Supported Eventstream Entra connection; receiver role
sources.validation: Dedicated consumer group; event_id count reconciliation

sources.label: IoT Hub
sources.validation: Registered device, device telemetry and event envelope mapping

sources.label: AWS Kinesis
sources.validation: Shard access, consumption and source normalization

sources.label: Azure Data Explorer
sources.validation: Consumer KQL reads source database without unintended duplicate ingestion
